bts.teaserSub: How one person and a lot of AI tools make a cat sitcom.
bts.title: Behind the scenes
bts.desc: How Three To Tango is made, and what AI has to do with it.
bts.intro: Three To Tango is made by one creator, using AI tools for the episodes and the artwork. No studio, no animators, no cat actors. The cats are not real. The chaos is relatable.
bts.p1: AI tools generate the images and video clips. A human writes every gag, picks every take, and edits the episodes together.
bts.p2: The characters, the humour, the timing and the decision to leave Caddy alone on her rug. Those are on purpose.
bts.p3: You should know how it is made. We will keep saying it, on every product and every page.

quiz.pageDesc: Seven questions. One verdict. Find out if you are a Luka, a Budy or a Caddy.
quiz.title: Which cat are you?
quiz.intro: Seven questions about your habits. No wrong answers, only revealing ones. Luka will not be consulted.
quiz.noscript: The quiz needs JavaScript. No JavaScript, no problem. Pick your verdict directly:
quiz.cardAlt: Your result card, 9:16 format for Instagram Stories
quiz.shareHint: Post it to your Story and tag us. Then see what the AI makes of you.
quiz.shareText: I took the Three To Tango quiz. Verdict:

luka.line1: You are clever, selective and slightly suspicious of everyone, including this quiz.
luka.line2: You want attention, but only when you ordered it. Anything else is an ambush.
luka.line3: You have a plan. You do not share the plan. You may be sitting on the bookshelf.

budy.line1: You have thoughts and you are going to share every one of them. Right now.
budy.line2: You love people, snacks and people with snacks. Silence makes you nervous.
budy.line3: Your phone battery and your group chat are both at risk.

caddy.line1: You are deeply unbothered. The world is on fire; you are on a rug.
caddy.line2: Your home is your kingdom and your calendar is mostly naps.
caddy.line3: You rarely react. When you do, people remember it for years.
